spawn.desc: launch an interactive agent in <project>; /spawn <project> --resume-session <uuid> [--hashtag <h>] resumes a session (e.g. a hand-opened one) in a screen, listener re-armed; add -- <claude flags> to forward --remote-control [name] / --model / --name (remembered for /resume and restarts)

resume.desc: bring a dead agent back by name: /resume <persona name | #hashtag | last 3 digits> (or tap /resume_<hashtag>) (finds its session + folder, resumes it in a screen; refuses while it is alive); -- <claude flags> as for /spawn

kill.desc: kill an agent: /kill <hashtag> (tele-* screen) or /kill <name|#hashtag|last 3 digits|pid:<PID>> [--restart] (any claude process of yours by persona / session name / hashtag / PID, owner only, SIGTERM; --restart resumes its session in a screen)

ls.desc: list running agents: one short line each (screen rows no 📺, 💻 = terminal; name #hashtag — omitted when /kill_ is shown; state as ⏳/💤/✋/🐚; context; 🔇/📬; 📁 folder last; sorted by folder a→z) + tappable /kill_ /nudge_ (owner, no /compact_); /ls full = two sections — 📺 screens, then 🖥 terminal claude processes — one block per agent with #hashtag and /compact_ /kill_ /nudge_: pid, 📨 session name (cross-session message address), folder, context use, listener/mail status; long lists come as several messages

lsf.desc: = /ls full: one block per agent, every attribute on its own line

whisper.desc: discreet steer into a topic: /whisper #<hash> <text> (or reply to a previous whisper)

instruct.desc: official private instruction to a topic; agent replies via DM: /instruct #<hash> <text> (or reply to continue)

health.desc: machine status: CPU load + CPU/disk-IO pressure (PSI), RAM/swap, disk, running agents (screen/terminal, busy), top memory users, warnings (CPU short / disk IO jammed by PSI, low RAM/disk, OOM kills in 24h), machine-lock queues (who holds build/merge/cleanup, who waits)

pending.desc: list convos waiting on an admin reply

broadcast.desc: owner only — system message to running sessions (those in /ls); you get a board of buttons to pick who receives it (all selected, tap an agent or a project to toggle, 📢 Gửi): /broadcast [--now] [--p:<dự án>[,…]] <text> (--now = gửi ngay không bảng; --p: = chỉ các dự án đó)

cswap.desc: Claude account switcher: /cswap (/cs) = list, <n> = switch, add, rm <n>, auto (one check; near the limit → switch to the account that resets soonest), upgrade; add/rm/remove/auto/upgrade/update/switch are reserved words, use switch <x> to force a switch

help.desc: list all commands + their sample syntax

merge.desc: merge GitHub PRs in order: /merge <project> <pr#> [<pr#> …] or /merge <PR URL> [<PR URL> …] [--squash|--merge|--rebase] [--keep-branch] [--force] (default squash; stops at the first failure; via the API, local checkout untouched); add --close to close PRs without merging

cleanup.desc: clean up now (runs daily anyway): removes worktrees whose PR is merged and that are clean + idle, and abandoned cargo target/ dirs; DMs a report when done. /cleanup --dry-run only lists. RFC 30 (owner): /cleanup alone lists the worktrees kept (a [🗑 n] button each, manual removal with a backup); /cleanup <word> shows only the kept worktrees whose repo, folder or branch contains it (no match → exact branch lookup); /cleanup </path or ~path> goes straight to one; /cleanup run = clean up now

restartd.desc: /restartd [<target>] [--force] — restart the daemon (systemd service) and tell <target> (name / #hash / 3 digits / convoId) when it is back; refuses while agents share its cgroup unless KillMode=process or --force

automerge.desc: agent merge requests: /automerge on|off · status (list repos) · add/remove <owner/repo | owner/*pattern*> — explicit allowlist only: _config.autoMergeRepos + added patterns

compact.desc: owner only — type /compact into an agent's tele-* screen: /compact <name | #hashtag | last 3 digits> (or tap /compact_<hashtag> in /ls full); same checks as /type 🗜️, result sent when done (RFC 26)

nudge.desc: owner only — type a fixed line into an agent's tele-* screen asking it to make sure its Telegram listener is on (listener off) and/or check its mailbox (mail waiting), then reply to pending messages — when neither (force), reply to what is pending or post a status: /nudge <name | #hashtag | last 3 digits> (or tap /nudge_<hashtag>); /nudge alone = every agent with listener off or unread mail (RFC 26)

type.desc: owner only — type /compact, /remote-control or ⎋ Esc into an agent's tele-* screen: /type (pick an agent) or /type <name | #hash | last 3 digits>; /compact when idle or busy (queued by Claude), /remote-control only when idle, Esc only when busy; 💀 kill (asks ✅ first, then /kill pid:) in any state; shows context use (RFC 22)

q.desc: owner only — control the heavy-build queue with buttons: build slots (1 / auto), max waiting tickets, kick, move to top, block an agent for a while, pause, stop a running build. Typed forms: /q max|slots|retry|kick|top|block|unblock|pause|resume (RFC 29)

reload.desc: re-read commands.json + projects.json without restarting the daemon

login.desc: owner, DM only — add a Claude account to cswap: /login = link, /login <code> = finish, /login cancel (RFC 40)
